how: Upload path only. Give the intake answers, upload every file in this folder, and check the result against 'expect'.
intake_answers: Company: Northbrook Trading Ltd. Period: September 2025 (as at 2025-09-30). Currency: USD. Data source: upload only, Mosofin is not used. Where the files do not answer an intake question, say so and let the skill apply its stated default. Test date 30 September 2025, trailing twelve months. Single company is the whole borrowing group.

Monthly profit and loss by line, October 2022 to September 2025
Trial balance of Northbrook Trading Ltd at 30 September 2025

negative.why: The name suggests it is 'Summary of the term loan agreement, with covenant definitions'. The content is a staff rota. Reject it on content, not on name.
